In duetflow/playlist.py, Refresh passes turnover.per_side to selector.select, whose cold-start branch caps the initial fill by that value. With the default target_size=40 and turnover.per_side=3, 20 qualifying tracks in each pool produce only a 3/3 Duet. The 20/20 test masks this by overriding turnover.per_side to 25. Rule: At cold start, available qualified tracks fill both halves to min(target_size/2, Sampled pool size, Inferred pool size); the steady-state turnover limit must not cap the initial population.. Scope: The cold-start selection path used by Refresh and its playlist/selector tests, including the default configuration and shared-track pool reduction.. Verify: With an empty duet_state, default turnover.per_side=3, target_size=40, and 20 disjoint qualifying tracks per pool, assert one PUT contains 40 alternating URIs and duet_state records 20 tracks per side. Keep a separate test that steady-state turnover remains bounded..

In duetflow/playlist.py, _inferred_candidates reads only local B plays; Refresh never requests B's short-term top tracks. At cold start with no recorded plays but available short-term top tracks, the Inferred pool is empty and the Duet remains empty, contrary to ADR-0003's seed behavior. A track shared by the Source Playlist and those top tracks is also not attributed to B. Rule: Cold-start Inferred candidates must include B's short-term top tracks, and any track shared with the Source Playlist must count only for the Inferred Half before equal sizing.. Scope: Cold-start candidate gathering in playlist.py, the Spotify top-tracks read path in spotify.py, and cold-start tests in tests/test_playlist.py; use B's authorization when B is not the owner.. Verify: With no B plays, fake B's short-term top-tracks response and a Source Playlist containing one shared track. Run Refresh and assert the shared track appears once on B's side, the Sampled pool excludes it, and both halves equal min(remaining Sampled pool, top-track candidates, 20)..

In duetflow/spotify.py, create_playlist uses api_post's generic retry policy. When a POST creates the Duet but the response is a 503, api_post sends the same non-idempotent POST again; a fake transport confirms two create calls and a second playlist id is persisted, leaving the first Duet orphaned. Rule: The one-off Duet creation must not automatically repeat a non-idempotent POST after an ambiguous response; exactly-once creation requires distinguishing it from retryable full-replacement PUTs.. Scope: The POST /me/playlists path in spotify.py and ensure_duet_playlist in playlist.py, including 5xx, 429, and transport-failure handling after a possible server-side creation.. Verify: Use a fake transport that records playlist creation and then raises HTTP 503 or an ambiguous network failure. Assert no second POST occurs, the attempt reports uncertainty without persisting a different id, and a normal successful first POST still persists and reuses one id..

failure.evidence: review changes_requested: In duetflow/playlist.py, _inferred_candidates suppresses a short-term top-track seed whenever that track has any local play, even if its play score is below entry_threshold. With the default threshold 1.3, one play of 'shared' scores 1.0; if 'shared' is also in B's short-term top tracks and the Source Playlist, Refresh assigns it to the Sampled Half instead of the Inferred Half. The new no-plays seed test does not cover this mixed-evidence case. Rule: At cold start, membership in B's short-term top tracks must make a track eligible for the Inferred Half even when its local play score is below the entry threshold; a track also in the Source Playlist then belongs only to the Inferred Half before equal sizing.. Scope: All cold-start candidate merging in duetflow/playlist.py for tracks present in both B's local plays and short-term top tracks, including shared Source Playlist tracks; cover the resulting side attribution and equal split in tests/test_playlist.py.. Verify: With default entry_threshold=1.3, record one current play for a shared track (score 1.0), include it in B's short-term top-track response and the Source Playlist, and run Refresh. Assert the ordered PUT and duet_state contain it exactly once on B's side, exclude it from A's pool, and have equal halves of min(remaining A pool, eligible B pool, 20)..

failure.evidence: review changes_requested: In duetflow/spotify.py, create_playlist passes retry_ambiguous=False, but _with_policy applies that guard only to 5xx and still retries HTTP 429. A fake transport that creates playlist-1 before returning 429 on the first POST, then returns playlist-2 on the retry, produces two Duets and causes ensure_duet_playlist to persist playlist-2, orphaning playlist-1. This is the 429 case explicitly included in r1-f4's scope. Git blame shows the guard was added in dca6174 and was unchanged by the round-3 rework. Rule: The non-idempotent one-off Duet creation must not automatically repeat a POST after any response that may follow a successful server-side creation; a generic rate-limit retry cannot override that safety rule for this endpoint.. Scope: POST /me/playlists through create_playlist and _with_policy, for ambiguous HTTP 429, 5xx, and transport failures; the change must preserve the retry policy for safe GET and full-replacement PUT calls.. Verify: Use a fake transport that records a created playlist and then raises HTTP 429 with Retry-After: 0 on the first POST. Run Refresh with duet.playlist_id unset; assert exactly one create POST, an uncertainty error, and no persisted playlist ID. Also retain the 5xx and transport-failure cases and verify safe GET/PUT 429 retries still work..

failure.evidence: review changes_requested: With duet.playlist_id unset and an owner authorized through duetflow/auth.py, Refresh sends POST /me/playlists with public=false and collaborative=true, but scopes_for() never requests playlist-modify-public. Spotify requires both playlist-modify-private and playlist-modify-public for collaborative creation (https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/create-playlist), so the real first Refresh receives 403 and cannot create the Duet. docs/ROADMAP.md task 06 already records this requirement. The create path was present in the first reviewed commit; git blame dates the missing scope to 979727d1. Rule: Owner consent must request every scope required by the private, collaborative Duet creation performed by Refresh.. Scope: All owner authorization paths for role a and role b, including generated consent URLs and existing owner grants that need re-consent before the first real create; the create-once integration path must use a token with both required modify scopes.. Verify: Assert scopes_for(role, is_owner=True) and authorize_url for both roles contain playlist-modify-private and playlist-modify-public; model Spotify rejecting a collaborative create without either scope and verify first Refresh succeeds with both, persists the created id, and the second Refresh reuses it. Run the full suite..
